summary: Follow-up falsification found no inspected downstream path that promotes UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE historical trade experiences into model qualification or execution. Runtime-configuration scorecards exclude historical records, Learning UI labels them outcome memory rather than forecast accuracy, and Adaptive Brain has no direct learning-experience coupling. The prior aggregate API/UI projection defect remains: time_quality is omitted, count-only MEASURED labels survive, and APEX wraps the whole learning snapshot as AVAILABLE.
surface: Historical experience downstream consumption, Adaptive Brain/APEX projection, and export/API boundaries

evidence.finding: experience_configuration_summary admits only RUNTIME_CLOSURE_CONFIG with CLOSURE_TIME_CONFIG, while historical records are separated into historical_artifact_configuration_summary; snapshot remains research-only with automatic production promotion and execution false. However generic experience_summary and historical artifact cards retain count-only MEASURED status without time_quality.

Regression tests verify UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE imports remain absent from by_configuration, and explicitly verify provenance classes without cross-promotion between RUNTIME_CLOSURE_CONFIG and HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT_CONFIG.
The UI states historical records are outcome memory, not forecast accuracy, and cannot enter runtime configuration. It still renders MEASURED cards without temporal-quality labels.
The authenticated /api/learning and /api/learning/experience routes return the learning snapshot and experience_state directly; no additional performance promotion is applied at the API boundary.
Full-file inspection found no learning-experience or historical-trade consumer coupling in the Adaptive Brain state builder.
safe_snapshot marks any structurally readable, non-authority-escalating learning snapshot AVAILABLE; it preserves the nested payload but does not inspect time_quality.
APEX embeds the learning snapshot read-only and does not derive model credibility from historical experience cards; learning is marked degraded only on adapter failure.
The current APEX UI does not render the embedded learning snapshot or its historical experience metrics.

daedalus.finding: Historical TradingView experience is provenance-partitioned and the inspected API, Adaptive Brain, APEX, and UI paths do not promote it into runtime-configuration scorecards, model qualification, production authority, or execution.

aegis.finding: The containment is not a substitute for correct semantics: aggregate cards omit UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE, use count-only MEASURED, the overall learner can be LEARNING from experience count alone, and APEX reports the readable subsystem AVAILABLE without temporal-quality inspection.

remediation: Preserve the existing provenance-class separation and negative cross-promotion tests.
Propagate time_quality into generic and historical aggregate cards and replace count-only MEASURED with an explicit structural-versus-temporal two-axis status.
Make APEX learning adapter status distinguish AVAILABLE_DEGRADED_EVIDENCE from causally qualified learning state.
Add an end-to-end API regression asserting historical UNVERIFIED_TIMEZONE survives /api/learning, /api/learning/experience, and any future Adaptive Brain projection.
